summary: Pre-existing variant: the jump condition is computed from NOT zr AND NOT ng instead of NOT (zr OR ng). Logically equivalent; one more gate.
changes: CPU.hdl: posout = And(Not zr, Not ng) instead of Not(Or(zr, ng)); jge/jmp combined in a different order.
limitations: Its comments call this a 'fast-path' that reduces gate delay; the Hardware Simulator does not measure delay, so that claim is unverified.
